title: Japanese-Style Blackeye Pea Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious keto-friendly stir fry made with blackeye peas, aromatic spices, and a hint of Japanese flavors.

ingredients.name: Aromatic Oil
ingredients.notes: such as sesame or avocado oil

instructions: Heat the aromatic oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the dense garlic and Japanese ginger; sauté for 1 minute.
Add the blackeye peas and green peas; stir to combine.
Cook for 5 minutes or until the peas are tender.
Stir in the coconut aminos; cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over a bed of shredded lettuce or with a side of cauliflower rice.
